text: [157] 67 tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano . katamehi tīhi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti .pe. atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano .
